answer: The gene expression (log2(TPM+1)) distribution across all cell lines in the dataset is moderately right-skewed (positively skewed): pooled skewness ≈ 0.69 (0.689708; adjusted Fisher–Pearson standardized moment coefficient G1, scipy.stats.skew with bias=False) computed over all 32,017,874 matrix elements (1673 cell lines × 19,138 genes). Mean (2.61) exceeds median (2.34), consistent with a large near-zero mass (silent genes) and a long right tail toward highly expressed genes (max ≈ 18.4).
